description:
Check whether a phone number can be onboarded for this client before handing over the onboarding link.

This tool only checks 360Dialog's own database and this client's channel quota. It does not ask
WhatsApp/Meta anything, so a number already active on WhatsApp elsewhere (including the personal
app) can still come back eligible here.

check_coex.description: Set to true if the phone number to check is currently on the WhatsApp Business app (not to be confused with the normal, personal, WhatsApp app.) WhatsApp Business app numbers can be onboarded to the API as well using WhatsApp Coexistence

name: check_number_eligibility
title: Check number eligibility
